name: flat scan
description: A flatbed scan of the sheet: even light with no perspective, a little dust, and a faint cool cast where the platen edge was.

prompt.default: a flatbed scan of the sheet: even unmodelled light, no perspective, a few dust specks, a faint cool cast at the edge
prompt.flux: the picture is a flatbed scan of the loose sheet, perfectly even light with no cast shadow and no perspective, a scatter of dust specks, a faint cool cast along one edge from the platen
prompt.sdxl: flatbed scan, flat even lighting, no perspective, no shadows, dust specks, slight cool cast, documentary
